_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Facilities Maintenance Report
summary: The Facilities Maintenance Report provides visibility into contractor preventive and corrective maintenance, time, and materials cost for government-owned property used in operations and maintenance contracts.
use_relationship: The Facilities Maintenance Report provides visibility into contractor preventive and corrective maintenance, time, and materials cost. This would include all government-owned property used in support of operations and maintenance contracts.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable when contractors are responsible for the operations and maintenance of facilities.
Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall consist of three sections grouping maintenance actions under the following categories:

children.title: Category I for real property and real property installed equipment.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Manhours, labor cost, and materials cost shall be for the current period for all categories.
children.content: Cumulative totals for the current fiscal year shall be for real property and real property installed equipment.

children.title: Type of maintenance and status of action.
